title: College kids and the success of 'Loch Lomond'
summary: College audiences made the record a success; note on the other vocalist on the 'Loch Lomond' record.

blocks.x: we call a month or so I think.
Yes. Well it's sort of a crazy business because --
The college kids were responsible for it being a success because I was singing at the Onyx Club around summer months, during vacation. We had a college kids come in the Onyx Club at the time.
And they went for it. It was the novelty of it.
There was no stopping us after that.
There is one minor point we need to make about 'Look Limited.' That is, you're not exactly the only vocalist on it, are you?
No, but (inaudible). 'You take the high road and I'll take the low road.'
